moves.7: After Trinity and Ikuzz, use the nearby bird to fly down

1: Assign two kicks to the Radiant Spellsower so it keeps walking in while the tank gathers. Lust once everything is stacked (Topicx)
5: Pull the Sporeblight Belcher first and the Virid Grovekeeper 5-6 sec later so the AoE and knockback do not overlap (Topicx)
7: Two Luminous Thornmaw are in this pull. Grievous Gash bleeds only fall off at full health (Method, Topicx)
10: The Potatoad Matriarch aggros as soon as you cross a spot on the floor. Approach after clearing the adds (Topicx)

run.title: +15 Murder Row - BIG Key Still Feels Easy

moves.13: Skip the big patrol in the middle of the hall: jump up onto the ledge, and everyone must make it before the patrol returns (Topicx).

1: Go right, pull the Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together and lust. Never pair them without lust. Kill the Captain first, then the Guard (Topicx).
Heartstop Poison stacks from Street Sneaks endanger the tank, so assign a poison dispeller (Topicx).
2: Line of sight the casters in the next room so they come out. The only must-stop cast is the Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (Topicx).
After the pull, click the Snitch and grab the gem from one of five spots in this area (trade it for the Concealed Pistol next to Kystia) (Topicx).
3: Gather the pack, go up the stairs, open the door and line of sight everything inside. Click the Snitch at the top of the ramp after (Topicx).
4: Stagger the rooms. The first door has two casters, so everyone stays clear of the doorway until they run out, then open the next door (Topicx).
Four Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison fast. Topicx recommends no more than two per pull (Topicx).
5: The Massive Felwyrm is the priority target. Call for a dispel on Corroding Spittle (Topicx).
6: Buy the Concealed Pistol with the gem at the vendor next to the boss and fire it as Nibbles nears 20%. Take Kystia to about 40% in the first Destabilized (Topicx).
7: After the RP, gather the melee worker packs and line of sight them outside; a DPS or healer opens the door. Taunt the boss as it spawns and use the second lust (Topicx).
8: The Shivan Punisher pulses the party below 50% until it dies, so pair it only with easy packs. Pull back a little so you do not body pull the side packs (Topicx).
9: Drain Life targets from the Corrupted Warlock must use a defensive, or it heals a lot. Demon Flies are fine to pull in numbers (Topicx).
10: Kick the Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel and chain into the Demon Flies. Focus the Shivan Punisher below 50% (Topicx).
11: Kill Felmaster Lucsei before more than three Blade Dances, and split personal and group defensives across them (Topicx).
12: Use the third lust on the second Demonic Rage (Topicx).
13: Pull the other packs on top of the imp pack. Use group defensives for the Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (Topicx).
15: Topicx advises against pulling the Shivan Punisher with the Corrupted Warlock: Drain Life, the sub-50% Demonic Frenzy and Curse of Doom together are lethal. They do not link, so pull the Warlock back first and take the Punisher separately (Topicx).
16: Burn the Defiled Golem within two AoE casts and assign two group defensives. Backpedal from Fel Beam toward the last boss (Topicx).
17: Drag the boss to the farthest corner on pull. Fighting near the green wall can pull mobs through it. Save damage cooldowns for the add spawns (Topicx).

run.title: +15 Voidscar Arena - INSANE Route Near 2 Chest

moves.7: Take the portal between the two wings to the Atroxus room

1: Pull the whole first hallway up to the Voidtouched Magi miniboss and lust it (Topicx)
Drag the Voidtouched Magi back around the corner into the room so the whole hallway trails in (Topicx)
Assign kicks beforehand: one player per shaman, and on the Magi's Shadowbolt Volley the tank kicks first and another player second (Topicx)
2: Go right at the starting fork and kill Raj'kess the Spellstorm. Kill the 3 Orb of Disruption orbs immediately and use defensives on Thundering Storm (Topicx)
3: Every mob in the room must die for Taz'Rah to spawn. Watch for the packs coming out of the left and right walls and gather them (Topicx)
The minibosses come out in order: Chitigoth, then Brutok. Use party survival utility and healing cooldowns on Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (Topicx)
4: Taz'Rah leaps into the middle and starts casting right away, so the tank waits in the middle beforehand (Topicx)
5: Pull the pack at the top of the stairs together with the Watchful Harrower. Don't miss the Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek kick (Topicx)
6: Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams overlapping a Watchful Harrower Sky Strike soak wipes high keys, so kill the Overseer before its next shield (Topicx)
7: Lust when the first Toxic Creeper spawns, or on pull if all DPS cooldowns are ready (Topicx)
8: Pull both packs together and add the patrolling Devouring Brutalizer when it walks over. Use DPS cooldowns here (Topicx)
Only one Devouring Brutalizer per pull (Topicx)
9: Wait for the patrolling Devouring Brutalizer to walk left and clear the path before grabbing the Scavenging Siphoids. Going too early pulls the Brutalizer (Topicx)
10: Chain in the Watchful Harrower once the Devouring Brutalizer is low enough to die before its next ability (Topicx)
11: All 3 Devouring Brutalizers must die to open the stairs to Charonus. Pull the leftover Scavenging Siphoids into Charonus and cleave them (Topicx)
Lust once it is back up (Topicx)

run.title: +15 Altar of Fangs - LITTLE Too Close

moves.6: Jump down into the boss area (Topicx).

1: Pull both Venom Leech packs into the first pull. In a PUG, leave the right staircase pack (Ritual Chieftain and 2 Primal Serpents) for later: one missed Piercing Hiss kick and the haste loss puts the tank in danger (Topicx).
If Ravenous Descendants live long and start hitting hard, use a defensive or stun them and kite (Topicx).
2: Pull the right staircase pack with the 2 Ravenous Descendants in the center. Blood Sacrifice hits hardest, so spend defensives on it (Topicx).
3: Line of sight behind the pillar so the Primal Serpents walk down instead of casting from the stairs. Three casters, so catch every kick (Topicx).
4: Wait for the 2 center Ravenous Descendants to move away from the Twinfang Harrowers before pulling, so you don't aggro the Harrowers (Topicx).
5: Only add small mobs like Venom Leeches to the Twinfang Harrowers. On high keys, pulling them with a Ritual Chieftain pack makes Blood Sacrifice plus the Paralyzing Shots DoTs too much to heal (Topicx).
Dodge the Toxic Breath frontals, and the healer tops the group when the DoTs go out (Topicx).
6: Party defensives go on the Ravenous Stomp AoE; damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield (Topicx).
7: This route plays it safe with a small pull here. Higher-key routes pull big here and use lust (Topicx).
An Envenom from the High Evolutionist landing right before the Rattling Writhe's Rattle stacks a DoT on top of the AoE, so that cast must be kicked (Topicx).
9: The far-left High Evolutionist tends to get ignored, so assign a ranged player to kick it and bring it in. Kill the High Evolutionist before its second Mass Envenom (Topicx).
10: Set the Toxic Atrophy kick order in chat before the pull. If you saved lust for this boss, use it on the Uncoil split (Topicx).
11: All 4 High Evolutionists by the totems must die before the totems can be clicked. Assign a kicker per Evolutionist and stun the Evolve casts (Topicx).
12: Click the totems once out of combat, then bring 2 Blade of the Altar onto the mini-boss for cleave. The tank pings a spot and the group stacks so the Infest circles drop together. Kill it before the third Infest (Topicx).
13: Don't dump all your damage cooldowns on the Living Venoms. If they all pop at once the group can wipe (Topicx).
14: Back-to-back Ula'tek's Chosen pulls are a low-key move only. Use party defensives during the Toxic Surge AoE, and stun the Blades of the Altar so they can't jump on teammates (Topicx).
15: Bring 2 Blade of the Altar into this pack (Topicx).
16: Ula'tek's Chosen with 2 Ritual Chieftains means back-to-back Blood Sacrifices on top of Toxic Surge, the heaviest healing check of the route. Kill the Chosen immediately, ideally before its second Toxic Surge (Topicx).
17: The tank pings a spot and everyone returns to the same positions every Ritual of the Fang. Party defensives go on the beam-soak channel (Topicx).

run.title: +14 Den of Nalorakk - MDT Tricks Us

moves.13: After Sentinel of Winter, click the orb to return to the start and head down the last path

1: Two Territorial Matriarchs, so an enrage soothe is a must. Without one, the tank rotates defensives (Topicx)
Kill the Starvation Effigy before it lands a second Insatiable Hunger curse. Feast of Misery on top of curses is a brutal overlap (Topicx)
When grabbing the berry bush offering, taunt the Keen-Eyed Striker that swoops in (Topicx)
First lust and cooldowns go on this pull (Topicx)
5: While the party clicks the barrels that spawn the boss, the tank pulls this pack and brings it to the boss area (Topicx)
6: Bring one or two poison dispels for the mushroom poison stacks (Topicx)
7: Cooldown pull after the boss. Pull only two of the three casters here: go clockwise around the outside and fight in the corner so you don't pull the middle or side packs (Topicx)
Two Territorial Matriarchs, so without a soothe the Physical damage is heavy. Have defensives ready (Topicx)
8: A lighter pull across the log, but two Matriarchs and a Terra Rumbler make it heavy on the tank (Topicx)
9: Frostfangs only hit the tank, so pull as many as you can handle. Pull the wolves only once the patrolling Avatar of Determination is heading away, or it gets socialed in (Topicx)
10: Cooldown pull after lust. Frigid Mauler casts are long and easy to kick (Topicx)
11: Kill the Avatar of Determination first, then the Terra Rumbler. Stack so everyone can break each other out of Glacial Tomb (Topicx)
Terra Rumblers have lots of health plus the absorb shield, so use anything that breaks absorbs (Topicx)
13: Skip the first two packs here (the casters don't move); drag the Grizzled Warbringer into the next pack instead (Topicx)
Use a defensive for Primal Echo on high keys (Topicx)
14: A third-lust option. On high keys save it for Loa Speaker Nanea (Topicx)
Magma Totems from two Ruthless Totemcallers plus caster damage add up, so kill the totems right away (Topicx)
15: The Grizzled Warbringers never cast Primal Echo at the same time. Healers top the group before the next one and use raid defensives if needed (Topicx)
As the pull ends, move up to start the Loa Speaker Nanea roleplay early (Topicx)
16: On high keys lust here. Aim to finish before a third Volatile Totem wave. Unless Nanea is around 10% health, kill the totems first (Topicx)
17: If you did not use the third lust on pull 14 or Nanea, use it here (Topicx)

run.title: +15 King's Rest - Easiest Dungeon This Season?

1: Stun the Minions of Zul on the way so the party can purge them. Do not fight the two Animated Guardians alone: drag them into the Shadow-Borne Champion pack in the next room. First pull of the dungeon, so lust it (Topicx)
Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind can one-shot on high keys, so everyone presses a defensive on every cast (Topicx)
2: Play the corner pack separately as a cooldown pull. Two Shadow-Borne Champions together means overlapping Shadow Whirlwinds and not enough defensives (Topicx)
4: Of the four groups, the one that loses its purple glow wakes up next. DPS hold cooldowns until the tank is on it and has threat (Topicx)
The hardest group is King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins: bleeds never stop, so use your potion here (Topicx)
King Rahu'ai casts about five Forked Lightnings and then Overload, so move the mobs out of it beforehand to keep melee uptime (Topicx)
5: Skipping the Purification Construct leaves you short on count and forces extra Animated Guardians at the start, so kill it. Backpedal it across the bridge out of each puddle and use group defensives when the healer falls behind. On high keys you can lust it (Topicx)
Near the end, pull the Embalming Fluids from the next room into it. They barely do anything (Topicx)
6: Fight with the whole party stacked by one coffin so the Entomb target lands in it and can be freed right away. Assign the two Half-Finished Mummy kicks (Topicx)
7: Do the same on the other side: everyone by one coffin. If people are spread out, finding the right coffin takes too long (Topicx)
9: Kill the two Spectral Shamans first so no more Healing Tide Totems spawn. The two Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop, so use AoE stops and stuns (Topicx)
10: On a four-lust route, this bridge pack is the third lust. Focus the Ghostly Brute (tank buster and an AoE to run from), though killing one shaman first is fine (Topicx)
Once the shamans are down, chain the next pack, and once the Ghostly Brute dies take the rest into the third boss (Topicx)
11: Bring the Royal Berserker and Honored Raptors in and kill them with Kula. Kula dying fast means fewer Whirling Axes (Topicx)
12: The tank engages first to take the Shadow Barrage. For Pool of Darkness, the tank soaks the near one and a ranged DPS or the healer the far one (Topicx)
13: Lust at the start of Dazar, or in phase 2 on a four-lust route. Kill Reban before 80% (Topicx)

run.title: +15 Ruby Life Pools - WITH Insane Recovery!

moves.5: After Melidrussa and her RP, ride the dragons up to the upper level

1: Gather everything up to the doorway. Deepstone Earthshaper Tectonic Strike stacks spike the tank early, so stun the Earthshapers at high stacks and kill the Primal Juggernaut first (Topicx)
2: Pull the two on the left and the caster, then gather the two by the other pool. Touching the eggs in the water spawns Infused Whelps that stack Cold Claws (Topicx)
3: Pull the four-pack and the caster into Defier Draghar. Bait Blazing Rush into a wall, never toward the unpulled pack next to it. Tank defensive for every Steel Barrage (Topicx)
5: Blazebound Destroyer Fiery Blast only hits the tank. Spend kicks on the Cinderweaver Cinderbolt first and stun the Ashseer Flamelasher channels. If those channels run long, the group dies (Topicx)
6: Pull Flamegullet once it walks close. Pulled from far away, its Flame Breath frontal covers a wide area. On +17 and higher, lust at 50% Flamegullet (Topicx)
8: Thunderhead patrols near this pack, so do not pull it. Afterward, skip on whichever side Thunderhead is not on (the tree or the right side) (Topicx)
9: Pull the Scorchlings in front of the boss into it and cleave them down (Topicx)
10: Tempest Channeler Thunder Blast only hits the tank; Lightning Torrent is the dangerous part. Once the Channeler dies, chain straight into the next Flamelasher pack (Topicx)
11: Keep chain pulling through this area (Topicx)
12: Grab the small mobs on the edge too so a DPS does not pull them by accident. Tempest Stormshield deals heavy party damage while up, so use cooldowns and defensives. Some teams lust Ryvati on high keys (Topicx)

run.title: +14 Temple of Sethraliss - Last Boss KINDA Spicy

1: Pull 1 has three Storm Adepts, so this route goes left at the start. Topicx now says right is better, with only one caster. Going left, you need kicks or grips to bring the first caster down, and you can line of sight at the end of the tunnel so everything walks around the corner (Topicx)
Kill the Sandfury Stonefist first. A Lightning Bolt landing with Ground Pound kills people, so never miss that kick and press a defensive for Ground Pound (Topicx)
2: The Shrouded Fangs at the bottom of the stairs are hidden. The tank must be the one to engage them first, not DPS or healers (Topicx)
Once the Stonefist is dead, you can drag the leftover small mobs into the first boss for extra cleave (Topicx)
3: Keep the bosses in the middle of the room. Mark the boss to attack with skull so DPS don't hit the wrong one (Topicx)
4: Coming down the bridge, wait a few seconds for the party to catch up before engaging the Sand-Sworn Rider. About 5 sec in it casts a Scouring Sand that can cover the whole bridge (Topicx)

Don't leave the Rider alive long: its Swarming Krolusks snap to DPS who are away from it. Drag mobs out of the lightning puddles, and once the Rider is dead with only small mobs left you can chain the next pack (Topicx)
5: Two casters, the Krolusk Matriarch and the Sand-Sworn Rider on the bridge all at once is dangerous. Gather the rest first and pull the Rider in once it nears the top of the bridge (Topicx)
A Lightning Bolt on someone already hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin is what kills here, so don't miss kicks (Topicx)
6: In the second area, when in doubt underpull: at most one Sand-Sworn Rider, one Brood Tender and two Lightning Serpents per pull. Faithless Subjugators are fine, their casts are long enough for one person to kick (Topicx)
7: As in pull 6, only one Rider. Drag mobs off the lightning puddles so they don't free-cast, and kick Venom Bolt so it doesn't land on someone with Cytotoxin (Topicx)
8: Before Hatch, note the eggs and grab the Storm Serpent first. Use group defensives for Serpentstorm (Topicx)
9: Just grab aggro on the hallway Agitated Nimbus and keep going. After the first Release Charge, once the healer has topped the group, run through the Loose Sparks, tank the Nimbus on the Spark Channeler and kill the Channeler first to stop the orbs (Topicx)
Chain the next pack right after another Release Charge so the two Nimbi desync. Don't let a cast through while the group takes AoE (Topicx)
10: A Nimbus, two casters and several Static Anomalies together is spicy. Have a potion or cooldowns ready, get both kicks before gathering anything else, and pulling after the first Release Charge is safer (Topicx)
11: Rotate the boss through the four corners, one per Induction Field. DPS soak the beams; the tank only positions the boss (Topicx)
12: The second Loose Sparks gauntlet before this is harder than the first and one-shots DPS on high keys. Take the extra seconds to dodge, then kill the Spark Channeler (Topicx)

Gather the no-count Faithless Conscripts for free cleave. Click the orb to spawn the Orb Watcher, tank on the side where one Temple Disruptor spawns and CC the other. Kick the Disruptors so the orb keeps charging (Topicx)
13: Once the orb hits 100% the Disruptors stop casting, so finish the rest. You can walk over here as soon as the first orb is done; handle this one the same way, then head for the exit toward the last boss (Topicx)
14: Pick up the Faithless Conscripts as you go. Faithless Tormentors only chase the healer, so slow and stun them, and kick the Twisted Hexxer. The faster this dies, the sooner the last boss starts; then talk to the NPC in the middle to begin (Topicx)
15: The first Corrupted Guardian spawns on the purple mark on the floor. Grab it right away and stack the Twisted Hexxer with it. The tank doesn't soak green circles while a Guardian is alive. In phase 2, step on the green orbs Tormentors drop quickly (Topicx)
